# Best home backup power stations under $1,000

**My pick: Bluetti Elite 200 V2.** It has the most battery for the money: 2,074 Wh, 2,600 W output, LiFePO4 cells rated for about 6,000 cycles, and a 5-year warranty. It lists at $899 ([Outage Outfitter](https://outageoutfitter.com/best/under-1000/), [Compare Power Stations](https://comparepowerstations.com/best/best-under-1000/)). A tested code, AFF5OFF, brings it to **$854.05** as of Oct 25 ([buy here](https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-elite-200-v2)). That link goes through Dealectric, which earns a commission. It's good for roughly 23 hours of fridge, CPAP and router ([Outage Authority](https://outageauthority.com/roundups/best-power-station-home-backup)). It can't be expanded with extra batteries.

One source ([Outage Authority](https://outageauthority.com/roundups/best-power-station-home-backup)) lists it at $1,199, but the other three show $899, so that looks like a stale price. Check the price at checkout.

## Other good options

| Need | Pick | Price | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| Room to expand later | Anker SOLIX C2000 Gen 2 | ~$900 | 2,048 Wh, 2,400 W, 10 ms UPS, and a BP2000 pack can double capacity ([Outage Authority](https://outageauthority.com/roundups/best-power-station-home-backup)). Prices and specs: [Compare Power Stations](https://comparepowerstations.com/best/best-under-1000/) |
| Best budget | Bluetti AC180 | $499, or **$474.05** with AFF5OFF | 1,152 Wh, 1,800 W, about 13 hours of fridge, CPAP and router. [Buy](https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-ac180) |
| Most capacity per dollar | Anker SOLIX F1500 | $599.99 | 1,536 Wh at $0.39/Wh, 600 W solar input ([Compare Power Stations](https://comparepowerstations.com/best/best-under-1000/)) |
| Lightest | Jackery Explorer 1000 v2 | $489 at Outbound Power | 1,070 Wh, 23.8 lb. Jackery's own store now charges $559 ([review](https://outageauthority.com/reviews/jackery-explorer-1000-v2)) |
| Cheap alternative | ALLPOWERS S2000 Pro | **$597.60** with ALLPOWERS26 | 1,451 Wh, 2,400 W. [Buy](https://dealectric.com/go/allpowers-s2000-pro-1451wh) |

## Which to choose
- **Multi-day outages or running more appliances:** Elite 200 V2, or the Anker C2000 Gen 2 if you might add capacity later.
- **Overnight outages (fridge, CPAP, router):** the AC180 is enough and costs about half as much.
- **Portability matters:** the Jackery 1000 v2, but it has no expansion and only 400 W of solar input.

## Caveats
- None of these will run a whole house. They suit a fridge, internet, CPAP, lights and device charging.
- Most of these specs come from the makers, and the sources say they haven't tested the units themselves. The exceptions are the Outage Authority runtime estimates and its Jackery review.
- I only have direct buy links for the Bluetti, ALLPOWERS and Jackery picks. For the Anker units, use the price comparison page above or Anker's own store.
- Promo codes and stock change often. The Bluetti Elite 100 V2 is currently out of stock at [Home Depot](https://www.homedepot.com/p/337557774).
